what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 2 of 4: The sphere formation law forgets its initial plane on the infinite lattice. Block 26 (PR #8170): executed, not proved: starting from an aligned plane the magnetization of the sphere formation law decays with no plateau for beta = 3..24 (exponents at or above gamma(beta) = c_0 A(3 beta)/(3 beta), c_0 = 3 sqrt 3/(4 pi)); the equilibrium twist argument fails in level time (recorded there under N1). Block 27 (PR #8171) proves uniqueness only for beta < 1/sqrt 3. TASK: prove that for every beta the law reached from an aligned plane has m_t -> 0 on the infinite plane (or for beta in an explicit larger range), or find the obstruction. Routes: (i) a relative-entropy argument in path space: compare the path measure with its image under a slowly varying rotation field theta(x, t); the cost per level is a Dirichlet form of the plane walk P and the benefit is the rotation of the mean; the two-dimensional recurrence of P is what should make the cost vanish; (ii) a comparison with the linear model using the monotonicity of A(kappa)/kappa (block 27's sign lemma); (iii) an O(3)-invariance plus ergodicity argument for the level automaton. State exactly which step fails if the route fails. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/plane-memory-loss/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
